VOCABULARY RENAMED to pass BUILD-TO-THE-TOOL (Akien's naming gate, 2026-07-25): a term must be DERIVABLE from its native-domain use — know how the word works on the water and its meaning here follows, with nothing to memorise. Four terms failed and were retired: `in_flight` (an AVIATION word inside a nautical system — a ship is never in flight), `berth_pending` (invented, not a maritime term), `docked` (a near-SYNONYM of berth, so nothing told a reader which of ours was which), and `journey` (which already meant CC's SESSION TRANSCRIPT elsewhere in this tree — one word, two meanings). Replaced by the real vessel progression AT SEA -> AT ANCHOR -> BERTHED, one continuous sequence any sailor knows, mapping exactly onto voyaging / arrived-awaiting-a-berth / tied-up-at-rest. `underway` SURVIVES on a different axis: at-sea is WHERE a boat is, under-way is THAT it is making normal progress (the calm unflagged count inside a gate) — the collision that killed the first proposal (`in_flight`->`under_way`) and was caught by reading before renaming. Net -3 names (falsifier 10 on bus-completion: a build adds no net new vocabulary).
